definitions.full: H5100. nehamah [ נְהָמָה ] noun feminine growling, groaning ; — only construct נָָֽהֲמַת : 1 Isa 5:30 of sea, in simile of growling of Assyr. Lion. 2 figurative groaning Psa 38:9 of heart ( מִנ ׳שָׁאַָ֫גְתִּי ).

occurrences.englishText: Lord, all my desire is before you.
